q: Is the AI intervention described (intended use, users, workflow integration)?
hint: What the AI does, for whom, at which decision point.

q: Are AI version, inputs, outputs and human-AI interaction specified?
hint: Model version, input requirements, output format, who acts on it and how.

q: Are eligibility, randomisation and on-site requirements for the AI clear?
hint: Site readiness, data quality gates, fallback when AI unavailable.

q: Are AI errors, harms and human override analysed?
hint: Error cases, adverse effects, disagreement handling.

q: Are AI-relevant outcomes and subgroup effects reported?
hint: Primary outcome plus AI-specific performance and heterogeneity.

q: Is enough shared to reproduce the AI arm (code, config, access)?
hint: Version pinning, access terms, computational needs.

q: Do the conclusions respect the trial's limits for the AI claim?
hint: No extrapolation beyond studied sites, populations and workflow.
